journalEntries.entry: I've been feeling overwhelmed with work lately. The constant deadlines and pressure are making me anxious, and I'm struggling to find a healthy work-life balance. Some days I feel like I'm drowning in tasks.

Today I had a breakthrough in therapy. I realized that my perfectionism stems from childhood experiences where I felt I had to be perfect to receive love and validation. This pattern has been affecting my relationships and self-worth for years.
I'm grateful for my supportive friends who listened to me vent about my relationship issues. Sometimes just being heard makes all the difference. I feel lighter after our conversation.

The panic attack I had during the meeting yesterday really shook me. My heart was racing, I couldn't breathe properly, and I felt like everyone was staring at me. I need to find better coping strategies for managing my social anxiety.

I've been practicing mindfulness meditation for two weeks now, and I'm starting to notice small changes in how I respond to stress. Instead of immediately reacting, I'm able to pause and breathe first.
